title: OpenAI's millennium proof dispute raises the question of whether researchers can trust AI labs
summary: The fight over an AI-generated proof of a millennium problem is heating up. Mathematician Tristan Buckmaster accuses OpenAI of academic fraud, CEO Sam Altman rejects the allegations. Terence Tao warns that cases like this could "reverse centuries of tradition in open science." The article OpenAI's millennium proof dispute raises the question of whether researchers can trust AI labs appeared first on The Decoder .
